content: Ligand 1 is a methylsulfamoyl benzamide morpholine - QED 0.907, the highest in the pool, but jnk3 exactly zero and SA 2.98, so it is a host, not a lead. Atom 0 is its N-methyl and the 0-1 bond is acyclic, so anchoring there keeps that single carbon and discards the other 24 atoms. The geometry question is worth revisiting. Back when activity was around 0.10 I measured meta and para arrangements of the two links as equivalent, and concluded placement did not matter - but at that point jnk3 was barely above noise, so the comparison had almost no power. Now that the para version sits at 0.41 the same test is meaningful: if meta still matches, the pharmacophore is tolerant and many more ZINC hosts become usable; if it collapses the way moving the pyridine methyl from C4 to C5 did, then the 1,4 relationship across the benzene is a real constraint I should respect. The surviving methyl becomes the pyridine 4-methyl and the fragment supplies a meta-substituted central ring. Expected product: N-{3-[(4-methylpyridin-2-yl)amino]phenyl}cyclopropanecarboxamide at 253 Da, the exact meta isomer of my best molecule.
